title: Architecture audit components manifest
description: Wire-format for an architecture-audit snapshot. The DETERMINISTIC substrate (physical_components, static direct-call edges, per-component metrics, git_sha) is produced by /components-extract; the JUDGMENT layer (classifications, smells, background-knowledge edges, prune verdicts, core_boundary) is produced by /audit-slice + /synthesize-audit. The treemap renderer is a pure function of this file.

project.description: Free-form project name for the header.

frame.description: Optional architectural frame label (e.g. 'prune-modularize-extend'). Omitted -> no frame badge.

git_sha.description: Commit SHA the snapshot was extracted at. Immutability stamp: a re-run produces a NEW snapshot, never updates an old one.

snapshot_id.description: Optional human label for this snapshot (date or tag). Defaults to audit_date in the header if absent.

extractor.description: Provenance of the deterministic substrate. Written by /components-extract; absent when the manifest was authored entirely by hand.

metric_descriptors.description: Self-describing metric model: key -> descriptor. The single source of truth (scripts/metric_registry.py) serialised into the manifest so the renderer's badge set, side-panel rows, and good/bad semantics are a pure function of this file. Absent -> the renderer falls back to a built-in default descriptor table for backward compatibility with pre-registry manifests.

pedagogy.description: Self-describing pedagogy block: classification / edge-type / evidence-class explainers, the direction encoding, per-metric explainers, the epistemic-source legend, and the concept glossary. The single source of truth (scripts/pedagogy_registry.py) serialised into the manifest so the renderer draws every (?) affordance and the glossary as a pure function of this file. Open object (additionalProperties allowed) and OPTIONAL: absent -> the renderer falls back to built-in defaults for backward compatibility with pre-pedagogy manifests.

cycles.description: Import cycles detected by Tarjan SCC over the static import graph (deterministic). Each is a strongly-connected component of size > 1: its members can all reach each other, so none can be changed in isolation (Acyclic Dependencies Principle). OPTIONAL: absent on hand-authored or pre-cycle-detection manifests.

finding_index.description: Optional lookup: smoke_finding / audit_slice tag -> human-readable record. Absent -> tags render as plain text.

evidence_class.description: How the edge was established. 'static' = detected by the AST/import-graph extractor (renders SOLID). 'audit-asserted' = drawn by a human/synthesis judgment, not statically detectable (renders DASHED). Absent -> renderer defaults direct-call to its own inference and everything else to 'audit-asserted'.

epistemic_source.description: How much a claim depends on information NOT in the code. 'measured' = deterministic (an AST/git/tool proved it). 'metric-anchored' = judgment biased by a metric (still judgment). 'requires-your-intent' = extrinsic; only a human naming a concern can ground it. The load-bearing provenance channel. OPTIONAL and backward compatible: absent classifications/edges still validate and render (the renderer derives a sensible default from the type/classification).

metrics.description: Deterministic substrate metrics, as an OPEN numeric map. Every value is a non-negative number; the set of keys is NOT fixed by this schema. The single source of truth for which metrics exist (their labels, units, badge thresholds, base/derived kind) is the metric registry (scripts/metric_registry.py), serialised into the top-level metric_descriptors block. Adding a metric therefore means registering it once — the schema accepts it here automatically, with no closed property-list to edit. The named entries below are documented for reference only; they are not exhaustive. All optional; the renderer shows badges only for metrics present. Produced by /components-extract; absent on hand-authored components.

fan_in.description: Count of modules that import/call this one.

fan_out.description: Count of modules this one imports/calls.

cyclomatic.description: Mean (or summed) cyclomatic complexity, e.g. radon cc.

churn_90d.description: Commits touching this component in the last 90 days.

test_ratio.description: Test LOC / source LOC for this component, where derivable.

refactor_pressure.description: Derived: churn * cyclomatic * fan_in / test_ratio. Surfaces the highest-leverage refactor targets. Computed by the registry from base metrics.

metric_descriptor.description: One metric's declaration, emitted from the registry. The renderer reads these to draw badges and panel rows; nothing here is required because pre-registry manifests omit the block entirely.

leaf.description: Orphan-gate exemption marker. True declares this logical component a genuine source-only leaf, so the validator's non-leaf-orphan check (validate_components.py, run under --strict by /synthesize-audit) tolerates it having zero logical-id edges after rollup. A 'removable' classification is exempted automatically; use this only for a non-removable node that is legitimately edgeless. Absent -> the node is treated as non-leaf and must be connected.

cycle_id.description: Id of the import cycle (cycles[].id) this component belongs to, if any. Stamped by the deterministic Tarjan SCC pass.

cycle_size.description: Number of components in this component's import cycle (>= 2).

derived.description: Provenance marker. True means this edge was produced deterministically by rollup_logical_edges.py from the physical static import graph. These edges are removed and re-derived on each rollup run (idempotent). Absent on hand-authored and physical static edges.
